title: feat: Mudlet GMCP message set + Dark Pawns client package
body:
**Base:** `main` (branched at 12f92885b; merges cleanly onto b467a0453, and telnet/session/game/package tests pass on the merge).

## Scope
Flagship-client work for launch: a Mudlet player connects, and gauges, map and chat work from GMCP data. Two commits:
1. `feat(gmcp)`: server message set, fired from the same game moments as the text it restates.
2. `feat(mudlet)`: the importable client package (`mudlet/`), its generator, and the opt-in `Client.GUI` offer.

Protocol reference: `docs/gmcp.md`.

## Fidelity fix (R1)
Negotiating GMCP called `SetWantsStructuredData(true)`, which makes `PageString` skip the pager (`pkg/session/pager.go:118`). **Every Mudlet player saw long text unpaged**, while plain telnet paged it. The census can't see this because its harness never negotiates GMCP. GMCP state is now its own `gmcpState` on the session and never touches structured mode. `TestGMCPPlainClientSeesIdenticalText` runs the same session, including a paged `help` screen, through a Mudlet-shaped client and a plain client over a real socket and requires byte-identical visible text. Mutation-checked: restoring the old call fails it.

## Per-message dispositions
All messages are sent **after** the text for their moment and restate only what that text showed (R4).

| Message | Fires at | C origin of the text |
|---|---|---|
| `Room.Info {num,name,area,environment,exits{dir:vnum}}` | every room render (`RenderObservationMessages` with a `RoomView`) | `look_at_room` (entry, `act.movement.c:266`, look, recall, teleport, summon, follow). **Not** on dark/blind renders ("Darkness", no name) or on `look <dir>` peeks |
| exits filter | — | `do_auto_exits`: closed doors omitted for mortals, shown to immortals |
| `environment` | — | `look_at_room` PRF_ROOMFLAGS sector names |
| `Char.Name` / `Char.Vitals` / `Char.Status` | on change only: ahead of each prompt, on combat damage, after `point_update` | `make_prompt` (`comm.c:1028`), `point_update` (`limits.c`); race/class strings are C `races[]` / `pc_class_types[]` |
| `Comm.Channel.Text {channel,talker,text}` | once per delivered line, per recipient | `do_say` :759, `perform_tell` :873 (tell/reply), `do_gen_comm` :1146 (gossip/auction/grats/shout/holler/newbie + NPC gossip), `do_gsay` :824, `do_ctell` :1451 |
| `Core.Supports.Set/Add/Remove`, `Core.Hello`, `Core.Ping` | client→server | per-module gating; all modules are sent until the client first negotiates |
| `Client.GUI {version,url}` | on GMCP enable, **only if `DP_MUDLET_PACKAGE_URL` is set** | — |
| `IAC EOR` after prompts | only when the client answers `DO EOR` | invisible telnet command; the oracle strips it (`internal/oraclediff/conn.go:74`) |
| MSSP `GMCP`/`MCCP`/`ANSI` = 1 | MSSP request | — |

**How channel lines are mirrored:** `Act`'s delivery loop moved verbatim into `actDeliver(…, deliver)`. `Act` passes plain `SendMessage`, and `channelAct` also reports the **same string** to the observer. The talker is `act()`'s own `$n` for that viewer, so an unseen speaker is `"Someone"`. `performAct` is pure, so rendering the talker a second time draws no RNG (R3).

**Versioning:** message set 1 (`session.GMCPMessageSetVersion`), with per-module versions negotiated through `Core.Supports`.

## Package inventory (`mudlet/`, 1.0.0)
- Right-hand dock: character line, HP/mana/move gauges, mapper, chat MiniConsole. The palette follows the site: oxblood-on-dark HP on the CRT canvas, with two muted extra hues for mana and move (a noted deviation, for legibility).
- Mapper keyed by vnum: rooms are placed one step from the room whose exit leads to them, exits are linked in both directions, unexplored exits are stubbed, new zones start at their own origin, and double-clicking a room walks there (`doSpeedWalk` → `getPath`).
- Adds `Comm.Channel` through `Core.Supports.Add`; asks Mudlet's starter UI (`BaseUI.standAside`) to step aside on a hand import.
- `dp` / `dp hide` / `dp show` / `dp clear`. Handlers are keyed so a reload doesn't stack them, and uninstall tears down the dock.
- `VERSION` (embedded by the server) and `CHANGELOG.md`; `README.md` has the install section.

## Deviations from the brief
- **No movement/consider/who aliases or text triggers.** The game already parses `n/e/s/w/u/d` and abbreviations; a client alias would shadow the game's own parser (R2).
- **No `Room.WrongDir`.** Absolute vnums in `Room.Info` make move queues unnecessary.
- **Old `Char.Items` / vars→GMCP bridge removed.** It had a nonstandard shape and no consumers (agents use the WebSocket vars protocol, which is unchanged).
- **TLS `:7778` is not implemented** (the listener has no TLS; the runbook defers it). The README says to leave "Secure" unticked.
- **`Client.GUI` is off by default.** The hosting URL is an owner decision.
- `PCClassTypes` corrected to C (`"Magic User"`; it had no callers) and `PCRaceTypes` added. `do_score` still uses the wrong tables and is tracked separately (score class/race R1 task).

## Test evidence
- `pkg/telnet/gmcp_test.go`: raw-socket harness. It negotiates like Mudlet (`DO GMCP`, `DO EOR`, `Core.Hello`, Mudlet's default `Core.Supports.Set` + `Add Comm.Channel`) and walks a four-room keep: a move, a wall, a closed door, back, a dark room, back out, then a `say`. It asserts the exact `Room.Info` JSON sequence, that each frame follows its room's text, that Char.* arrives before the first prompt, vitals dedupe, the `Comm.Channel.Text` payload, and EOR only after prompts. Plus the plain-client twin test above.
- `pkg/game/out_of_band_test.go`: text is byte-identical with and without an observer; mirrored lines equal delivered lines; an unseen speaker is "Someone"; the norepeat ack isn't mirrored; dark, blind and peek don't fire; `PointUpdate` notifies once; race/class tables are pinned to C.
- `pkg/session/gmcp_test.go`: Supports gating (Set/Add/Remove, parent and child entries), Add sends current state, JSON shapes and field order, vitals-before-prompt, autoexit filtering (mortal vs immortal), observer routing, Client.GUI on/off/no re-offer, Core.Ping, and that GMCP never sets structured mode.
- `cmd/mudlet-package`: the committed XML matches its sources, round-trips through XML, the version is single-sourced (VERSION = `mudlet.Version` = newest changelog entry), and every script loads into Lua 5.1 against a Mudlet API stub while a session replays through the gauges, map, chat, speedwalk, reload and uninstall. Mutation-checked (a flipped north offset and stacked handlers both fail).
- Gates: `go build`, `go vet`, `go test ./...`, `golangci-lint` (0 issues), gofumpt; new tests also pass under `-race`.

## Not verified here
- **Full census** (per house rules, runs at review). Plaintext paths are unchanged by construction, and the twin test covers the telnet surface.
- **A real Mudlet import and visual drive.** To try it: `ENVIRONMENT=development go run ./cmd/server -port 4360 -telnet-port 7780`, then connect Mudlet to `localhost:7780` and import `mudlet/darkpawns.xml`.
